visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a frantic, high-speed shot of an overcast gray sky filled with thousands of tiny black swallows darting in every direction. Bright white radial speed lines are overlaid on the frame, and large, bold white text flashes in the center. (2) A young woman with dark bangs, wearing a gray hooded sweatshirt and a mask pulled under her chin, stands in front of a traditional Chinese temple gate. The gate is ornate with red and gold pillars and detailed carvings. She speaks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with her hands. (3) The camera pans up to show a large, multi-tiered circular temple pagoda featuring colorful murals of mythological figures and a distinctive red roof. The sky at this moment is relatively clear with only a few distant birds visible. (4) A sequence of quick cuts shows the woman pointing to the sky and checking her watch. The background lighting suggests early evening. A few more swallows begin to appear as dark specks against the pale sky. (5) The bird flock suddenly intensifies, forming a massive, swirling cloud that orbits the temple's towers and decorative roofs. The woman is now wearing a translucent yellow plastic raincoat, twirling and looking up in amazement in the temple courtyard. (6) Final shots capture the bird swarm at its peak density, looking like black pepper scattered across the sky. The woman continues to interact with the camera, laughing and gesturing toward the thousands of birds circling overhead.
